smallest_next_verification_unit: On the pinned serial host, add a verifier-owned matrix with zero Source plus at least one divergence-compatible static Source and one stage-varying Source/escape case; compare dense vs hybrid velocity and modified pressure through a full trajectory.
Repeat at dt=0.002 and dt=0.001 for the same final time on one sparse-preserving case and one densifying case; record velocity/pressure differences and end-to-end cost.
Emit explicit final/all-step Hermitian-conjugacy and kinetic-energy diagnostics instead of inferring them from initial validation or the shear analytic case.
